newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks closes up on positive sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks closes up on positive sentiment.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed more than three percent higher on Monday as the market responded positively to a change in leadership in the bourse council, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) benchmark index rose 32.86 points or 3.03 percent at 1,116.65 on a turnover of 59.2 million taka. Of 127 traded issues, 105 gained and 20 lost.
The DSE governing council on Monday removed controversial chairman Imtiyaz Husain and replaced him with councillor Abdul Haq Howlader. A recent inquiry found Husain involved in price manipulation.
Beximco Pharma gained 8.34 taka to 145.10 and Monno Fabrics rose 1.29 to 137.
